answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 31 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in signal, verified in sparrow, and beacon names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and therefore paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. A 238 account operation therefore ties up 4 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
